D: Two kids trying to catch Santa on camera crash his sleigh and have to help him save Christmas.
P: Serve the cookies when the kids set up the camera to catch Santa.
S: Kate's plan to catch Santa on camera
Choc chip cookies left out on a plate as bait, the best way to lure Santa into the shot.
Crisp fries with gravy for dipping, a quick bite on a busy night in Chicago.
M: a family missing their dad at Christmas
Glazed meatloaf with mashed potatoes and gravy, warm family food for a hard Christmas. Mix 800g beef mince with a diced onion, 1 egg and 60g breadcrumbs.
W: Iced sugar cookies cut into stars and reindeer for the wild ride across the sky.

s.note: Kate's plan to catch Santa on camera
s.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g brown sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 200g flour and 150g chocolate chips. Roll 16 balls and bake at 180C for 11 minutes.
Bake 1kg frozen chips at 220C for 25 minutes, turning once. Whisk gravy powder into 300ml boiling water until smooth and serve on the side for dipping.

m.note: a family missing their dad at Christmas
m.how: Mix 800g beef mince with a diced onion, 1 egg and 60g breadcrumbs. Press into a loaf tin, brush with tomato sauce and bake at 180C for 1 hour. Serve with mash made from 800g potatoes.

w.how: Beat 200g butter and 100g icing sugar, add 1 egg yolk and 300g flour and chill. Roll, cut and bake at 170C for 12 minutes, then ice.

d.how: Heat 1L milk until steaming and whisk in 150g chopped milk chocolate. Pour into 4 mugs and add a handful of marshmallows to each. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
